title: 第一卷 第7章 下次我不让你单独发疯
slug: 全网黑上恋综后我爆红了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

弹幕狂刷。

【哈哈哈哈哈主持人：我只是个打工的。】

【宋尔尔别太真实。】

【单向心动对象！节目组会搞。】

【陆执表面淡定，心里估计爽了。】

周闻野举手：“那我呢？”

主持人：“周闻野和姜眠一组。”

姜眠松了口气。

周闻野也点头：“行。”

分组结束后，工作人员拿上来三张任务卡。

主持人说：“今天的任务是——心动早餐外送，每组需要用节目组提供的一百元经费，在附近生活街区购买食材，制作一份早餐，并送给指定路人。路人会根据味道、创意和互动感打分。分数最高的小组，可以获得今晚优先选择房间约会地点的权利。”

宋尔尔听完，问：“一百元？”

主持人点头：“对。”

宋尔尔：“两个人？”

主持人：“对。”

宋尔尔：“买食材、做早餐、送路人、还要互动？”

主持人：“是的。”

宋尔尔：“你们节目组算盘打得不错。”

主持人笑：“尔尔觉得经费少吗？”

宋尔尔：“不，我是觉得你们适合去开公司。”

主持人：“为什么？”

宋尔尔：“因为很会用一百块买两个人的命。”

陆执低头喝豆浆。

肩膀轻轻动了一下。

【哈哈哈哈哈一百块买两个人的命。】

【打工人狠狠共情。】

【节目组：经费有限。宋尔尔：压榨无限。】

主持人已经学会了不和宋尔尔纠缠。

他立刻宣布：“那么现在，请各组准备出发。”

宋尔尔站起来，拿起节目组给的任务信封。

陆执站在她身边。

两个人一前一后往门口走。

宋尔尔低声说：“陆老师。”

陆执：“嗯。”

宋尔尔：“你会做饭吗？”

陆执：“会一点。”

宋尔尔放心了：“那就好。”

陆执看她：“你呢？”

宋尔尔很坦然：“会吃一点。”

陆执：“……”

宋尔尔拍拍他的肩：“别怕，我精神上支持你。”

陆执：“支持到什么程度？”

宋尔尔想了想。

“你做饭，我夸你；你失败，我安慰你；你炸厨房，我报警。”

陆执看她两秒。

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

The barrage was blasted.

[Hahahahaha Host: I’m just a part-time worker.】

[Song'er, don't be too real.】

【One-way love object!The program team will do it.】

[Lu Zhi looked calm on the surface, but he was probably feeling happy in his heart.】

Zhou Wenye raised his hand: "What about me?"

Host: "Zhou Wenye and Jiang Mian are in a team."

Jiang Mian breathed a sigh of relief.

Zhou Wenye also nodded: "Okay."

After the grouping, the staff brought up three task cards.

The host said: "Today's task is to deliver heart-pounding breakfast. Each group needs to use a hundred yuan of funds provided by the program team to purchase ingredients in nearby living neighborhoods, make a breakfast, and deliver it to designated passers-by. Passers-by will score based on taste, creativity and interaction. The group with the highest score will get the right to choose the room date tonight."

After listening to this, Song Er'er asked: "One hundred yuan?"

The host nodded: "Yes."

Song Er'er: "Two people?"

Host: "Yes."

Song Er'er: "Buying ingredients, making breakfast, giving food to passers-by, and interacting with each other?"

Host: "Yes."

Song Er'er: "Your program team made a good plan."

The host laughed: "Do you think the funds are low?"

Song Er'er: "No, I think you are suitable to start a company."

Host: "Why?"

Song Er'er: "Because I know how to buy two people's lives with a hundred yuan."

Lu Zhi lowered his head and drank the soy milk.

His shoulders moved slightly.

[Hahahahaha. One hundred dollars can buy two lives.】

[Beat the workers and empathize hard.】

[Program team: Funds are limited.Song Er'er: There is no limit to the squeeze.】

The host has learned not to get entangled with Song Er'er.

He immediately announced: "Now, please prepare each group to go."

Song Er'er stood up and picked up the task envelope given by the program team.

Lu Zhi stood beside her.

The two people walked towards the door one after another.

Song Er'er whispered: "Teacher Lu."

Lu Zhi: "Yeah."

Song Er'er: "Can you cook?"

Lu Zhi: "I know a little bit."

Song Er'er was relieved: "That's good."

Lu Zhi looked at her: "What about you?"

Song Er'er was very calm: "I can eat a little."

Lu Zhi: "..."

Song Er'er patted him on the shoulder: "Don't be afraid, I support you mentally."

Lu Zhi: "To what extent do you support it?"

Song Er thought for a while.

"If you cook, I will praise you; if you fail, I will comfort you; if you bomb the kitchen, I will call the police."

Lu Zhi looked at her for two seconds.
